subject: Export permissions + audit logging review (Usage Insights beta)
content:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Kaitlyn Nguyen <kaitlyn.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 27, 2026 at 4:12 PM PST
Subject: Export permissions + audit logging review (Usage Insights beta)

Hi Marcus/Kevin —

Before we flip the Usage Insights beta flag for the first cohort, we want security sign-off on (a) who can export CSV and (b) what audit events we emit + retention constraints.

Current implementation direction (matches PRs in flight):
- Export is async: POST /v1/usage-insights/exports -> export_id, then poll GET status, then GET signed download URL.
- Signed download URL TTL: 15 min.
- Export files stored in our export bucket and deleted by lifecycle.

Open items we need your guidance on:

1) Permissions / RBAC
- Proposal: require "Billing Admin" OR "Workspace Admin" for any view of costs + exports.
- Workspace setting: "Hide cost data" (if enabled, cost views + exports are blocked even for non-admin roles; only Workspace Admin can override).
- Restricted workspaces ("regulated" tag): default exports disabled until explicitly enabled by Workspace Admin.

2) Audit logging requirements
We currently emit:
- usage_insights.export_requested
- usage_insights.export_completed

Questions:
- Do we also need a distinct usage_insights.export_downloaded event (server-side on download URL hit)?
- Do we need to log IP/user-agent? (we can capture from request headers)
- Any restrictions on storing filter params in logs? We currently log filters JSON (time range, project_id, route, model)

3) Retention constraints
- Proposal (beta): export object retention = 72 hours, then hard delete.
- Telemetry retention is unchanged; export is just a snapshot.

I attached a quick permissions proposal + draft audit schema fields.

Attachments:
- usage-insights-export-permissions-proposal-v1.pdf
- usage-insights-audit-events-schema-v2.csv

If you can reply with required changes + "OK to enable beta" conditions, we’ll fold into INT-9140 and finalize.

Thanks,
Dylan

—
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Lead, Console & Tooling
Redwood Inference


-----

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Kaitlyn Nguyen <kaitlyn.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 27, 2026 at 5:01 PM PST
Subject: Re: Export permissions + audit logging review (Usage Insights beta)

Dylan —

Yes, we need export_downloaded. We have to be able to answer “who downloaded what, when” for enterprise audit requests.

A few requirements/edits:
- Default deny: exporting cost data should require an explicit “can_export_cost” capability (we can map this to Billing Admin + Workspace Admin, but please don’t key off role name strings in code).
- Regulated/restricted workspaces: exports OFF by default is correct. Also: no shareable links for restricted until we do a separate review.
- Audit fields: include actor_user_id, actor_email, workspace_id, export_id, time_range_start/end, and request_id/correlation_id.
- Log the route/model filters but avoid logging raw prompt, raw user content, or headers.
- IP address: yes (source IP) and user_agent: yes.

Retention: I’d prefer 24 hours rather than 72 for the export objects. If customer needs longer, that should be a paid/explicitly configured exception later (not beta).

Marcus

—
Marcus Lin
Security Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference


-----

From: Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Kaitlyn Nguyen <kaitlyn.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 27, 2026 at 5:28 PM PST
Subject: Re: Export permissions + audit logging review (Usage Insights beta)

+1 to Marcus.

Two additional notes from prior export reviews:

1) Download event semantics
- We should emit export_downloaded when the signed URL is redeemed (GET to the download endpoint / redirect), not when the URL is generated.
- Include status (success/failure) and bytes_sent if possible. Even “started” + “completed” is okay if bytes is hard.

2) Filters in audit logs
- OK to store route/model IDs and time range.
- For anything that can explode cardinality or contain customer identifiers, store normalized values only.
  Example: route should be canonicalized (templated) not raw path.

Retention
- Agree on 24 hours for object retention for beta.
- Also: make sure lifecycle deletion is enforced even if export job fails halfway.

Kevin

—
Kevin Osei
Security Engineer
Redwood Inference


-----

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Kaitlyn Nguyen <kaitlyn.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 27, 2026 at 6:14 PM PST
Subject: Re: Export permissions + audit logging review (Usage Insights beta)

Got it — thanks.

We’ll implement the following changes:

Permissions
- Add a dedicated capability gate (can_export_cost) checked in the query service.
- Initial mapping: Billing Admin + Workspace Admin => can_export_cost.
- Respect “Hide cost data” workspace setting (blocks exports; only Workspace Admin can toggle the setting).
- Restricted workspaces: exports disabled by default; no share links in beta.

Audit events
- Add usage_insights.export_downloaded with:
  actor_user_id, actor_email, workspace_id, export_id, request_id/correlation_id,
  ip_address, user_agent, time_range_start/end,
  filters: {project_id, environment, route_template, model_family, model_version_bucket},
  status + bytes_sent (if available).
- Keep export_requested + export_completed.

Retention
- Change export object TTL from 72h -> 24h.
- Ensure deletion lifecycle applies regardless of job success (we’ll enforce a delete-on-complete best-effort + bucket lifecycle as backstop).

I’ll update INT-9140 and the PRs accordingly. If Naomi is OK with the role mapping + “Hide cost” behavior, can you both reply with a “security approve for beta” once the changes are in?

Dylan


-----

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Kevin Osei <kevin.osei@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Kaitlyn Nguyen <kaitlyn.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 27, 2026 at 7:03 PM PST
Subject: Re: Export permissions + audit logging review (Usage Insights beta)

Approved on product side.

The capability gate + restricted default-off is consistent with our beta criteria, and “Hide cost data” is the right lever for customers who want to let engineers use the console but keep finance-only access to cost.

Marcus/Kevin — once Dylan lands the changes + audit event additions, please treat that as sign-off for enabling the beta allowlist.

Naomi

—
Naomi Feldman
Product Owner, Security & Permissions
Redwood Inference
